info.title: Unify Compute dashboard API
info.description: The /dashboard/v1 routes the dashboard pages call (ADR-0011, docs/spec/accounts.md). Served by compute-api only with ACCOUNTS_BACKEND=local and only on the app host (Host = APP_ORIGIN's host, else 404); with the console backend none of it exists. Not part of the job API contract (compute-api/internal/api/openapi.json): no API key is accepted here and no cookie there. Every non-GET needs Origin = APP_ORIGIN; session routes need the __Host-uc_session cookie and, for non-GET, X-CSRF-Token. compute-api/internal/dashboard tests hold this document's operations against the registered routes. Balance, history, usage and the account's jobs (A7d) reuse the job API's objects by reference to openapi.json; top-ups (B1), export and close are not here yet.

post.description: Needs the password entered in this session within the last 10 minutes (login, verify, POST /reauth or POST /password); otherwise 401 reauth_required, checked before the body. The response carries the secret, which is never returned again. The account's address gets the "A new Unify Compute API key was created" email, and a key_created audit event is written. At most 10 active (neither revoked nor expired) keys per account; at most 20 creations per account per hour.

get.description: Balance entries, newest first, as a cursor list: pass the previous page's next as after. Every movement of the balance is one entry (admin_credit, hold, extend, settle, release, and later topup, refund, …). An operator adjustment's reason and audit reference are internal and never shown; a hold's id is replaced by the job it belongs to.

get.description: What the account was charged in one UTC calendar month: the settles accepted in it, by SKU, summed in quota units and converted once, so total_usd equals the sum of the month's settle entries and, for a job settled within the month, its settled_cost_usd. gpu_seconds counts the seconds each settle added. Usage accrued but not yet settled is not included (it is at most a few minutes of a running job; the Job object's usage shows it). storage_usd and egress_usd stay 0.0000 until the R5 daily charges exist (metering.md).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, UTC. Absent is the current month.

session.name: __Host-uc_session
session.description: Host-only, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax. Idle 12 h, absolute 7 d. Non-GET requests also send X-CSRF-Token with the csrf_token from login, verify or /me.

param.description: The field to show the message under; absent for the form-level box.

Key.description: An API key's metadata. The secret is never part of it.

id.description: The key id; DELETE /keys/{id} takes it, and jobs record it as the key that submitted them.

display.description: `uck_` and the first 8 characters of the secret, to recognise the key by.

scopes.description: `jobs`: submit, cancel and read jobs, events, logs and artifacts. `read`: read only. Always in the order jobs, read.

last_used_at.description: Unix seconds of the last job API request, to within a minute; null if never used.

revoked_at.description: Unix seconds; null while not revoked.

CreatedKey.description: The key just created, with its secret. This is the only response that ever carries the secret.

secret.description: The whole key, for `Authorization: Bearer` on the job API. Shown once; only its SHA-256 is stored.

held_usd.description: Reserved for running jobs; what a job does not use comes back when it ends.

amount_usd.description: The one figure a history row shows: for settle, the charge taken out of held (negative); for every other kind, the change in available.

job_id.description: The job a hold, extend, settle or release belongs to; null otherwise.

ref.description: What caused the entry, when the account holder can see it; null for an operator adjustment.

detail.description: sku, for entries that belong to a hold. Nothing else, and never an operator's reason.

next.description: Present when has_more: the last entry's id, to pass as after.

by_sku.description: GPU time by SKU, sorted by SKU.
